# Matcher evaluation (generated by `python -m src.postprocess sweep`)

Eval side of the val split: records of the half-B val S1s plus half of the sampled other records, scored over 220,683 half-B S1 ids (12,451 singletons). F0.5 is the competition macro F0.5 over those S1s, including true pairs that blocking or pruning lost. **Corrected** counts each false positive from an 'other' record as 10 (those records were sampled at 20% and then halved). It cannot add back the singletons that the unqueried 90% would have hit, and records of half-A S1s never appear on the eval side, so even the corrected score is somewhat optimistic.

**Chosen threshold t = 0.79** (max corrected F0.5). Uncorrected F0.5 peaks at t = 0.56 (0.9361).

| metric | uncorrected | corrected |
|---|---|---|
| macro F0.5 | 0.9345 | **0.9302** |
| macro F0.5, india (88,340 S1) | 0.8934 | 0.8882 |
| macro F0.5, us (132,343 S1) | 0.9619 | 0.9582 |
| pair precision | 0.9964 | 0.9695 |
| pair recall | 0.8729 | 0.8729 |
| singleton accuracy (no prediction) | 0.9907 | - |
